title: Launch HN: Tokenless (YC S26) – Automatic model switching to save money
summary: Tokenless is an API gateway that automatically routes AI agent traffic between different models turn-by-turn to optimize costs, addressing the challenge of exploding AI spend at companies like Uber and Salesforce.
problem_solved: Helps companies reduce AI inference costs by automatically switching between expensive frontier models and cheaper open-source models based on task complexity.
why_valuable: It provides significant cost savings on AI spending without sacrificing quality by intelligently routing requests to the most cost-effective model for each task.
